inlines.v: DISTINGUISHABLE, adjective 1. Capable of being distinguished; that may be separated, known or made known, by notes of diversity, or by any difference. A tree at a distance is distinguishable from a shrub. A simple idea is not distinguishable into different ideas. 2. Worthy of note or special regard.
